lessons.concept: Form validation ka matlab hai user ko galat data bhejne se rokna. Agar koi 'Name' field khali chhod de, toh JS humein batayegi ki wo zaroori hai. Ye website ki 'peheli security' hai.

<input id='name' placeholder='Name'>
<button id='send'>Send</button>
<script>
  send.onclick = () => {
    if(name.value === '') alert('Enter name!');
  };
</script>

code_breakdown.explain: Ye property batati hai ki user ne box mein abhi kya likha hai.
Ye check karta hai ki kya field khali hai (=== '').
User ko browser level par warning dene ka quick method.

lessons.common_mistake: Input tag ki 'value' property bhool jana. Sirf 'id' likhne se content nahi milta, '.value' zaroori hai.

lessons.title: Project 5: Dark Mode Portfolio
lessons.concept: Dark mode user experience (UX) ko improve karta hai, khaas kar raat ke waqt. Iska logic simple hai: Ek CSS class (jaise '.dark') banao, aur JS se jab button click ho, toh poori body par wo class 'toggle' (add/remove) kar do.
lessons.example_code:
<button id='themeBtn'>🌙 Mode</button>
<style>
  .dark { background: #111; color: white; }
</style>
<script>
  themeBtn.onclick = () => document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
</script>

code_breakdown.explain: Ye CSS class hai jo background ko black aur text ko white kar degi.
Poore webpage ka container (body tag) select karne ka tareeka.
Ye magic command hai: agar '.dark' class hai toh hata dega, nahi hai toh add kar dega.
Ye ek 'shortcut' event handler hai jo button click hone par code chalata hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Poore web page ka theme change karne ke liye kisse select karna best hai?
Class ko on/off karne ke liye ______ method use hota hai.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya toggle karne se CSS file ki properties apne aap apply ho jati hain?

lessons.mini_task: Ek button banao. Click karne par page ka background black aur text white ho jaye. Dobara click karne par original (light) mode mein aa jaye.
lessons.why_it_matters: Dark mode ab har professional application (Instagram, YouTube) ka basic feature hai.
lessons.common_mistake: CSS file mein .dark class likhna bhool jana. JS sirf class add karegi, design CSS mein hi likhna hoga.

lessons.title: Project 6: Todo List App
lessons.concept: Todo list ek aisa project hai jo 'DOM Manipulation' ka king hai. Ismein hum HTML mein naye elements (li) banate hain aur unhein JavaScript se list mein jodte hain. Ye project sikhata hai ki browser mein naya data live kaise dikhate hain.

code_breakdown.explain: Browser ke memory mein ek naya HTML tag (li) banane ka command.
Naye element ke andar text likhne ke liye.
Naye banaye hue element ko main 'list' (ul) ke andar daalne ka command.
Task add hone ke baad input box ko dobara khali (empty) karne ke liye.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Naya HTML element JS se banane ke liye kya use hota hai?
Element ko list mein add karne ke liye ______ method hai.

lessons.mini_task: Ek input aur button banao. Button click karne par input ka text ek list (ul) mein naye item ki tarah add hona chahiye.
lessons.why_it_matters: Real apps mein naye comments, messages ya notifications add karne ke liye yehi technique use hoti hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Naye element ka textContent set karna bhool jana. Agar text nahi doge, toh screen par khali list item dikhega.

lessons.title: Project 7: Mini Calculator
lessons.concept: Calculator ek perfect project hai user input aur operators ko samajhne ke liye. Ismein hum do inputs lete hain, unhe `Number()` mein convert karte hain (kyunki JS default mein input ko string manta hai), aur fir math operations perform karte hain.
lessons.example_code:
<input id='n1' type='number'>
<input id='n2' type='number'>
<button id='add'>Add</button>
<script>
  add.onclick = () => {
    const res = Number(n1.value) + Number(n2.value);
    alert('Result: ' + res);
  };
</script>

code_breakdown.explain: HTML input mein sirf numbers allow karne ke liye.
Bahut zaroori! JS input value ko 'text' samajhta hai, Number() use convert karke 'math' karne layak banata hai.
Arithmetic operator jo do values ko jodta hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: JS mein input value ko number mein badalne ke liye kya function hai?
Calculation ke liye ______ operator use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Input value ko number mein badlo.

quiz_after_practice.question: Agar Number() use na karein, toh '1' + '1' kya hoga?

lessons.mini_task: Do input boxes aur ek 'Multiply' button banao. Click karne par dono numbers ka product dikhao.
lessons.why_it_matters: Billing apps, finance dashboards, aur e-commerce carts mein calculations core logic hoti hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Input value ko convert na karna. '5' + '5' math mein 10 nahi, '55' (text) hota hai.

lessons.title: Project 8: Digital Clock
lessons.concept: Digital clock pehla project hai jahan code khud-ba-khud chalta hai. Hum `setInterval` ka use karte hain, jo har 1 second (1000ms) baad ek function repeat karta hai. Ismein hum JavaScript ke `Date()` object se real-time time nikalte hain.

code_breakdown.explain: Ek aisa timer jo har 1000ms (1 second) baad code repeat karta hai.
JS ka built-in object jo computer ka current time/date uthata hai.
Current time ko readable format (12:00:00 PM) mein convert karta hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: setInterval mein 1000 ka matlab kya hai?

practice_reps.instruction: Time ko clock element mein daalo.

lessons.common_mistake: 1000ms ki jagah 1 likhna. 1 likhne se code itni tezi se chalega ki browser hang ho sakta hai.

lessons.title: Project 16: Copy to Clipboard
lessons.concept: Aaj kal 'Copy Link' ya 'Copy Coupon' button har jagah hote hain. JavaScript ki 'Clipboard API' browser se direct text user ke phone ke clipboard mein save kar deti hai. Ye ek chhota feature hai par user ka kaam bahut aasaan kar deta hai.
lessons.example_code:
<input id='txt' value='Hello'>
<button id='copyBtn'>Copy</button>
<script>
  copyBtn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt.value);
    alert('Copied!');
  };
</script>

code_breakdown.explain: Browser ka official tool jo clipboard control karta hai.
Ye method text ko clipboard mein save karta hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Clipboard mein text likhne ke liye kaunsa method hai?

lessons.common_mistake: Animation mein 'infinite' likhna bhool jana. Isse spinner bas ek baar ghoom kar ruk jayega.

lessons.title: Project 19: Music Player UI
lessons.concept: Music players mein 'Play' aur 'Pause' button ke beech switch karna 'State Management' ka basic example hai. Ismein hum ek variable (boolean) ka use karte hain jo track karta hai ki music abhi chal raha hai ya nahi. Ye logic tumhare saare interactive projects ka base banega.
lessons.example_code:
<button id='playBtn'>▶ Play</button>
<script>
  let isPlaying = false;
  playBtn.onclick = () => {
    isPlaying = !isPlaying;
    playBtn.textContent = isPlaying ? '⏸ Pause' : '▶ Play';
  };
</script>

code_breakdown.explain: Ek variable jo music ki 'state' (status) ko save rakhta hai.
Logical NOT (!) operator. Ye true ko false aur false ko true mein flip kar deta hai.
Ternary operator. Ye 'if-else' ka short version hai. Agar true, toh Pause; nahi toh Play.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Variable ki value ko flip (true/false) karne ke liye kaunsa operator sahi hai?
If-else ka short version ______ operator kehlata hai.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya ternary operator bina condition ke kaam kar sakta hai?

lessons.why_it_matters: Spotify, YouTube aur har video player isi 'toggle state' logic par kaam karta hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Ternary operator mein '?' aur ':' ka order bhool jana. Yaad rakho: Condition ? TrueValue : FalseValue.
